name: owned-module-boundaries
goal: Preserve helper definitions, callable contracts and dependency direction in owner-local modules

evidence: Audit found mismatched private filenames and core forwarding imports into workflows. Runtime contracts must follow actual owner layers without losing callable exports or unit identities.

The migration ledger checked definitions and colocation but omitted split utility names and runtime entry contracts. Extend the frozen ledger and existing project detection tests with native cold-import checks.
Committed test 7d14589d fails 31 canonical placement gaps and three owner-layer runtime assertions; immutable red 3519734beaf1c5921864ba7be66ea5d75e8a60db57459de1fbcb026686bba7c4.

Renamed split helpers to exported names; grouped initializer implementation helpers under owner-local lib folders. Core retains lower-layer definitions and types; registered internal runtime entries aggregate their callable APIs from workflows. Restored retired unit ownership.
Separate fix 11896e81 passes the unchanged placement and native runtime API tests. Both immutable checkpoints used one stable shell environment and the complete frozen test corpus.
